deferral.reason: Merged in #506/#573 but the NixOS option services.aiOncalld.enable (nix/modules/services/oncalld.nix:11) is set to true nowhere under nix/, so the systemd unit never runs; the dashboard route only loads lib/oncalld_engine.py on demand. Found in the 2026-10-28 P3 retro-review.

Merged in #504/#510. The writer (scripts/ai/aq-human-intervention:44-52) appends to .agents/delegation/control/<task_id>.jsonl; only local-agent tasks drain that queue (agent_executor.py:2752 via control_channel.poll), nothing in a production path invokes aq-human-intervention (only scripts/testing/test-human-intervention.py), and sub-agents dispatched by other lanes never read the spool. live_caller is the closest real consumer, which does not reference the entrypoint name. Found in the 2026-10-28 P3 retro-review.

Found in the 2026-10-28 P3 retro-review.
